instruction: Guide me on how to turn on notifications for incoming emails in Thunderbird.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling notification alerts for new email messages in Thunderbird. This is done by setting the mail.biff.show_alert preference to true. The evaluator uses the existing check_thunderbird_prefs function to verify this boolean preference value in the prefs.js file.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves Thunderbird prefs.js file from the expected location
Metric correctly parses prefs.js and checks the specific preference mail.biff.show_alert
Expected value (mail.biff.show_alert: true) is semantically correct for enabling email notification alerts
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird before file retrieval to ensure prefs.js is written to disk
Metric handles None result gracefully when file retrieval fails (returns 0.0)
Complete coverage of instruction requirement - verifies the exact setting for email notification alerts
Expected type handling is correct - uses type:rule and metric accesses rule dict properly
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Static type warning about get_vm_file return type (Union[Optional[str], List[Optional[str]]]) vs metric parameter (str) is acceptable since metric handles None correctly

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
